name: postId
label: Post ID
help: Pick a post (the newest 300 are listed: the start of its text and its status), or map an `id` from **Create a post**, **Search posts** or **Watch post events**.

name: accountIds
label: Accounts
help: Leave empty to delete the post from every account where it is published. Instagram and TikTok have no delete API: those accounts keep it, with a notice saying so.
